notes: A2A aircraft: Onward reads the real condition from AccuSim (cylinders, magnetos, filters, tires, brakes, flaps and more) instead of keeping its own, and the Hangar shows the parts that need attention
With AccuSim, Onward no longer adds its own wear or failures on top of A2A's. Maintenance is done in the A2A tablet, and Onward picks it up
Fouled spark plugs are shown on their own and don't count against the engine
